instructions:
1. Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes slightly out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
2. Shift your weight to the right leg, bend the right knee and push the hips back into a side squat.
3. Keep the left leg straight and the chest up.
4. Push through the right heel to return to center.
5. Repeat on the left side, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the working knee tracking over the toes, not caving inward.
2. Sit the hips back rather than letting the knee drift forward.
3. Keep the chest tall and core braced for balance.
4. Exhale as you push back up to center.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended, palms facing forward.
2. Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders by bending the elbows.
3. Keep the upper arms still and squeeze the biceps at the top.
4. Lower both dumbbells under control to full extension.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the upper arms pinned to your sides; do not swing.
2. Drive the lift with the biceps, not momentum.
3. Lower slowly to load the muscle on the way down.
4. Exhale on the way up, inhale on the way down.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand, elbow resting on the floor at about 45 degrees from your body.
3. Press the dumbbell straight up until the arm is fully extended.
4. Lower under control until the elbow lightly touches the floor.
5. Finish all reps on the right, then switch to the left.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the wrist stacked straight over the elbow.
2. Let the elbow tap the floor without bouncing.
3. Brace your core to resist rotation toward the loaded side.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
2. Hold a dumbbell in your right hand with the elbow tucked close to your body and resting on the floor.
3. Press the dumbbell straight up until the arm is fully extended.
4. Lower under control, bringing the elbow back to your side and touching the floor.
5. Finish all reps on the right, then switch to the left.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the elbow tucked tight to maximize triceps work.
2. Stack the wrist over the elbow throughout.
3. Brace your core to resist rotation toward the loaded side.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in your right hand.
2. Press the dumbbell overhead until the arm is fully extended.
3. Keep the wrist straight and the dumbbell stacked over the shoulder.
4. Walk forward in a straight line, keeping the weight steady overhead.
5. Lower the dumbbell, switch to the left hand, and walk back.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the biceps near the ear and the arm locked out.
2. Brace the core to stop the torso leaning to either side.
3. Take short, controlled steps.
4. Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath.
